name: Keep Streamlit Alive

on:
  schedule:
    # Executa a cada 6 horas todos os dias
    - cron: '0 */6 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch: # Permite disparar o teste manualmente

jobs:
  ping:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Ping Streamlit App
        run: |
          curl -I -s https://gestao-ria-ygwvbzvfu7eec2i7zsljcg.streamlit.app/ || true
